excerpt.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强[This.GetName]上各种各样的发电活动。
excerpt.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on [This.GetName].

texts.zh: [From.GetName]恒星系内的首要光耀体正在发出非凡的祥光。占星专家对此进行讨论后，我们理解了其能量的盈余将会增强[This.GetName]上各种各样的发电活动。
texts.en: The primary luminary in the [From.GetName] system is shining with extraordinary luster. After discussing this phenomenon with astrological specialists, we understand that its excess of energy will enhance all manners of power generation on [This.GetName].

label.en: May the stars shine brightly upon us.

texts.zh:
在[From.GetName]恒星系探测到一艘废弃的战舰缓缓飘过。舰船的设计和任何已知帝国都不同，也没有任何可辩识的旗帜或徽记。

在深度的评估和一些小修小补之后，我们的[This.GetEngineerPlural]认为这艘船现在已经符合服役条件了。
texts.en:
A deserted combat vessel has been detected drifting through the [From.GetName] system. The ship's design does not resemble that of any known empire, bearing no recognizable flag or insignia.

After an extensive appraisal and some minor repairs, our [This.GetEngineerPlural] have declared that the ship is now fit for active service.

tooltips.zh: 在该恒星系内获得一艘巡洋舰级舰船。
tooltips.en: Gain a cruiser class ship in the system.
